mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM RECEIPT_DATE) IN (3, 4, 5) THEN '봄' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM RECEIPT_DATE) IN (6, 7, 8) THEN '여름' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM RECEIPT_DATE) IN (9, 10, 11) THEN '가을' ELSE '겨울' END AS SEASON , COUNT(*) AS PATIENT_COUNT FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM RECEIPT_DATE) = #{year} GROUP BY CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM RECEIPT_DATE) IN (3,4,5) THEN '봄' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM RECEIPT_DATE) IN (6,7,8) THEN '여름' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM RECEIPT_DATE) IN (9,10,11) THEN '가을' ELSE '겨울' END

SELECT TO_CHAR(PAYMENT_DATE, 'MM') AS MONTH , SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS REVENUE FROM PAYMENT WHERE PAYMENT_STATUS = '수납완료' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM PAYMENT_DATE) = #{year} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(PAYMENT_DATE, 'MM') ORDER BY MONTH

WITH patient_first_visit AS ( SELECT MEMBER_NUMBER, MIN(RECEIPT_DATE) AS FIRST_VISIT_DATE FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER GROUP BY MEMBER_NUMBER ), monthly_visits AS ( SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(r.RECEIPT_DATE, 'MM') AS MONTH , r.MEMBER_NUMBER , TRUNC(r.RECEIPT_DATE, 'MM') AS VISIT_MONTH_START FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.RECEIPT_DATE) = #{year} ) SELECT mv.MONTH , COUNT(DISTINCT mv.MEMBER_NUMBER) AS TOTAL_PATIENTS , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pfv.FIRST_VISIT_DATE < mv.VISIT_MONTH_START THEN mv.MEMBER_NUMBER END) AS REVISIT_PATIENTS FROM monthly_visits mv JOIN patient_first_visit pfv ON mv.MEMBER_NUMBER = pfv.MEMBER_NUMBER GROUP BY mv.MONTH ORDER BY mv.MONTH

WITH medicine_revenue AS ( SELECT '약물처방' AS CATEGORY, SUM(dp.TOTAL_QTY * m.UNIT_COST) AS AMOUNT FROM DOCTOR_PRESCRIPTION dp JOIN MEDICINE m ON dp.MEDICINE_CODE = m.MEDICINE_CODE WHERE dp.PRESCRIPTION_STATUS = 'Y' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dp.PRESCRIPTION_DATE) = #{year} ), injection_revenue AS ( SELECT '주사' AS CATEGORY, SUM(oi.DOSAGE * m.UNIT_COST) AS AMOUNT FROM OUTPATIENTNURSE_INJECTION oi JOIN MEDICINE m ON oi.MEDICINE_CODE = m.MEDICINE_CODE WHERE oi.INJECTED_YN = 'Y' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.INJECTION_ORDER_TIME) = #{year} ), therapy_revenue AS ( SELECT '물리치료' AS CATEGORY, SUM(cc.UNIT_PRICE) AS AMOUNT FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS pr JOIN COMMONCODE cc ON cc.CODENAME_1 = pr.TREATMENT_ITEM_NAME AND cc.CODENAME_2 = pr.THERAPY_TYPE AND cc.COMMONCODE = 'P' WHERE pr.TREATMENT_STATUS = '완료' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pr.DATE_OF_TREATMENT) = #{year} ) SELECT CATEGORY, NVL(AMOUNT, 0) AS AMOUNT FROM medicine_revenue UNION ALL SELECT CATEGORY, NVL(AMOUNT, 0) AS AMOUNT FROM injection_revenue UNION ALL SELECT CATEGORY, NVL(AMOUNT, 0) AS AMOUNT FROM therapy_revenue

SELECT TO_CHAR(RECEIPT_DATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AS DAY_OF_WEEK , COUNT(*) AS PATIENT_COUNT FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM RECEIPT_DATE) = #{year} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(RECEIPT_DATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN')

SELECT CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(RECEIPT_DATE, 'HH24')) < 12 THEN '오전' ELSE '오후' END AS TIME_SLOT , COUNT(*) AS PATIENT_COUNT FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM RECEIPT_DATE) = #{year} GROUP BY CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(RECEIPT_DATE, 'HH24')) < 12 THEN '오전' ELSE '오후' END

SELECT (FLOOR( CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('1', '2') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (1900 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('3', '4') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (2000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) ELSE 0 END / 10) * 10) || '대' AS AGE_GROUP , COUNT(*) AS PATIENT_COUNT FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NUMBER = m.MEMBER_NUMBER WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.RECEIPT_DATE) = #{year} GROUP BY FLOOR( CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('1','2') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (1900 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('3','4') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (2000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) ELSE 0 END / 10) * 10 ORDER BY AGE_GROUP

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DIAGNOSIS_NAME, COUNT(*) AS DIAGNOSIS_COUNT FROM MEDICAL_RECORD WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM START_DATE) = #{year} AND DIAGNOSIS_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DIAGNOSIS_NAME ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_COUNT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(PAYMENT_DATE, 'HH24')) < 12 THEN '오전' ELSE '오후' END AS TIME_SLOT , SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS REVENUE FROM PAYMENT WHERE PAYMENT_STATUS = '수납완료' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM PAYMENT_DATE) = #{year} GROUP BY CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(PAYMENT_DATE, 'HH24')) < 12 THEN '오전' ELSE '오후' END
SELECT NVL(SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT WHERE PAYMENT_STATUS = '수납완료' AND TRUNC(PAYMENT_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
